process.title: Compliant Recycling Process
process.subtitle: Every stage adheres to transparency, worker safety, and systematic resource recovery.
process.step1Desc: Systematic intake of retired business electronics and bulk enterprise scrap.
process.step2Desc: Trained manual segregation of circuit boards, telecom modules, and ferrous metals.
process.step3Desc: Physical disassembly into primary components, separating hazardous batteries safely.
process.step4Desc: Carefully packaged material dispatch to verified industrial recyclers and refiners.
process.step1Detail: Commercial lots and enterprise electronic hardware are logged and assigned traceability tracking codes upon intake at our Chittagong handling hub.
process.step2Detail: Trained sorting teams classify circuit board grades based on component density, multilayer plating, and IC architecture to ensure pure batches.
process.step3Detail: Subassemblies are physically dismantled using specialized tools. Batteries and hazardous capacitors are isolated into certified storage drums.
process.step4Detail: Graded materials are packaged into export-ready super sacks or drums, palletized, and loaded into shipping containers for maritime transit.
process.safetyBadge: Worker Safety & Zero Informal Acid Leaching
process.safetyTitle: Strict Policy Against Informal Chemical Refining
process.safetyDesc: E-Waste Chittagong operates purely on physical dismantling, sorting, and mechanical segregation principles. We strictly prohibit crude open-burning, acid bath leaching, or environmentally destructive chemical stripping. All downstream pyrometallurgical refining is conducted exclusively by licensed, accredited international smelters.

about.title: About E-Waste Chittagong
about.subtitle: Dedicated to responsible e-waste aggregation, systematic material separation, and international circular economy trade.
about.p1: E-Waste Chittagong operates at the vital intersection of regional electronic asset retirement and global resource recovery. Based in Bangladesh's foremost maritime gateway city, our organization collects discarded computer equipment, server infrastructure, telecommunication boards, and industrial electronics from corporate enterprises.
about.p2: Our core mission is to replace informal, hazardous e-waste handling with structured, transparent B2B procedures. We prioritize the safe separation of dangerous substances—such as lead solder and lithium accumulators—while maximizing the extraction yield of high-value non-ferrous and precious metal-bearing components.
about.p3: All materials prepared for export or domestic industrial supply undergo systematic grading and packaging according to international industry specifications, allowing certified global smelters and refiners to process them efficiently.
about.policyDesc: E-Waste Chittagong upholds strict factual transparency. All facility specifications, material lots, and business details are verified prior to formal commercial execution.
about.missionDesc: To provide safe, ethical, and economically viable electronic waste recovery solutions that divert hazardous electronics from local landfills into the global circular supply chain.
about.portDesc: Our strategic position near Chittagong's seaport reduces inland transportation overhead, facilitating prompt container stuffing, customs clearance, and global ocean freight dispatch.
about.readinessDesc: We cater to overseas refiners and recyclers with multilingual communication, formal Proforma Invoices, clear assay test terms, and FOB / CIF shipping arrangements.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.subtitle: How E-Waste Chittagong collects, handles, and protects information submitted by international buyers and corporate clients.
privacy.guarantee: Strict Corporate Guarantee: We never sell, share, or disclose prospective buyer contact details or quotation specifications to third parties.
privacy.sec1Desc: When you submit a Request for Quotation (RFQ) or contact inquiry through our platform, we collect company identifiers, contact representative names, business email addresses, contact telephone numbers, and material procurement specifications.
privacy.sec2Desc: Data gathered is utilized exclusively to formulate formal commercial offers, calculate FOB/CIF freight rates from the Port of Chittagong, confirm inventory readiness, and fulfill international trade documentation requirements.
privacy.sec3Desc: All submitted records are encrypted in transit and stored within protected database environments with strict role-based administrative access controls.
privacy.sec4Desc: You may request the review, correction, or deletion of your company's commercial records at any time by contacting our compliance desk at info@ewastechittagong.com.
